body:
Fixes #13766
Fixes #13765

Two-card, one-file flight: encodes the two mechanical 余项 from the 2026-08-31 director batch #20 rulings (items ⑤ and ④, director session `session_01KGtaLpkW1mycWgkbSb3H6t`) into `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` — one sentence per card, per-member commits.

Maintainer verbatim (batch reply, untranslated): 「#13765 是分诊席自己的问题，完全可以处理完，他的定时到达时如果上一批还没处理完就接着处理呗。其他同意」

## Commit 1 — authoritative carrier of a recorded ruling (ruling ⑤)

Added to the 升级与决策 section, immediately after the atomic ruling-recording clause (③ 四件同笔): the authoritative carrier of "a ruling is recorded" is the director seat's per-sitting closing summary ledger; the ruling comment on the card is demoted to elaboration — still the first landing for execution and review, but existence disputes are settled by the ledger.

Ruling comment (2026-08-31, verbatim, untranslated):

> **B 生效**:自本裁起,「一条裁决已记录」的**权威载体 = 总监席每场收工的摘要台账**(座位贴 #12708 世系,条目最小形状照既有:卡 · 权威引文 · 方向 · 状态转移);卡上的裁决评论降为**详注**(elaboration)—— 详注仍是执行与复核的第一落点,但存在性之争以台账为准

## Commit 2 — a fire arriving mid-round continues the round (ruling ④)

Added to the 分诊座位职责 section's 发现分诊轮 paragraph, immediately after the 断点续跑 clause: a fire is a continuation trigger, not a reopen obligation; the backlog continues oldest-first, not re-sorted by a new fire; crossing fires is not carded as a contradiction.

Ruling comment (2026-08-31, verbatim, untranslated):

> 溢出语义由本裁补齐:**定时到达时上一批还没处理完 ⇒ 接着处理** —— fire 是接续触发,不是重开义务;一个清空轮次可以跨多个 fire,存量按最老优先继续消化,⛔ 不因新 fire 重排、不因跨 fire 视为违规

> 把第 2 条接续语义写进 SKILL 分诊席职责段(一句话量级的澄清:「fire 到达时上一轮未清空 ⇒ 接续处理,轮次可跨 fire」),防止下一任席位把「跨 fire 未清空」再当矛盾立卡
